tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer tender document for all the terms & conditions

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have provided at least 02(Two) numbers of vehicles (Tata sumo/ Mahindra Bolero/Neo). In proof of this, the bidder should submit single work order copy of having provided 02 numbers of vehicles (Tata sumo/ Mahindra Bolero/Neo) and work completion certificate for the said work issued by competent authority in the last five years.

The Bidder shall be a regular Contractor / agency and shall have proven experience in providing similar vehicles (Tata sumo/ Mahindra Bolero/Neo) to Govt., Organizations / Public Sector Undertakings / Institutions/MNCs

The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs. 45.56Lakhs in at least two financial years in any of the preceding five financial years i.e., 2025-26,2024-25, 2023-24,2022-23, 2021-22. As a proof of this, the bidder shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate / Profit & Loss statement duly certified by a chartered accountant

The bidder should have executed the contracts successfully to the satisfaction of the order placing party without any default. The bidder shall have to submit the experience/performance certificates(s) in original in this regard. The experience/performance certificates(s) should reflect minimum quantities as stated above for minimum qualifying criteria
